observation.command: echo "=== system_setting sample ==="; mysql -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qisutu.system_setting;" 2>&1; echo "=== ticket count ==="; mysql -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qisutu.ticket;" 2>&1; echo "=== queues/states ==="; mysql -N -e "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='qisutu' AND (table_name LIKE '%queue%' OR table_name LIKE '%state%' OR table_name LIKE '%priorit%');" 2>&1; echo "=== ownership ==="; ls -ld /opt/qisutu /opt/qisutu/bin/cgi-bin /opt/qisutu/var/tmp /opt/qisutu/var/cache
